activities.title: Run a report while the runner's role grant is being changed mid-execution
activities.trigger: An administrator revokes a role while a long report is running.
activities.narrative: The runner's access state is read once, at the start of the run, and held as locals for the duration. Within one call the field authorization is memoized; across calls nothing is cached at all. So a grant change during a run takes effect on the next run, not partway through this one — which is the only behaviour that yields a self-consistent result set.
